fqa-content-0: EasiCoin offers three types of savings products: Flexible, Fixed-Term and Flash Sale.
fqa-content-1: Flexible Savings can be subscribed to at any time. Interest starts accruing on T+1 (UTC) after successful subscription, and daily interest for the previous day is distributed starting on T+2 (UTC). Earnings are credited automatically to your Spot Account on a daily basis. Flexible Savings has no fixed term and can be redeemed at any time. Redemption amounts are credited to your Spot Account immediately upon submission, and no interest is accrued for the hour in which redemption is processed.
fqa-content-10: The redemption rules vary for different Earn products. Some support manual early redemption, while others can only be automatically redeemed upon maturity. Please check the specific product rules. If the product supports early redemption, users can click "Redeem" under the product positions in the Earn account, enter the redemption amount, and submit it after confirmation. The redemption settlement time varies for different Earn products. Once the redemption is credited, users can view the credited amount and fund records in their Spot account.
fqa-content-11: Users can view all currently held positions of Earn products in the Earn account. By clicking "Earn Orders" on the Earn account page, users can view historical orders related to product subscriptions, interest distributions, redemptions, etc. Fund records can be viewed in the Spot account by selecting the "Earn" type, which shows all records related to Earn, including subscriptions, interest distributions, and redemptions.
fqa-content-2: Fixed-term products can only be subscribed to during the designated subscription period. After a successful subscription, interest starts accruing from the product start date and is calculated from the day following the interest start date (UTC). The yield is distributed at maturity, and for maturity payout products, the funds are automatically redeemed and credited to the spot account on T+2 (UTC) after maturity.
fqa-content-3: Flash Sale allows subscription only to fixed-term Earn products, and early redemption is not supported early redemption. They are automatically redeemed at maturity. After successful subscription, interest accrues from T+1 (UTC). The yield model is "Maturity Interest Payment". For maturity payment products, the funds are automatically redeemed and credited to the spot account on T+2 (UTC) after maturity, and the redemption amount is returned to the spot account on the day following the product's maturity date (UTC).
fqa-content-4: Current products support "Auto-Subscribe." If "Auto-Subscribe" is enabled, the system will automatically use the available balance in your Spot Account to subscribe to the current wealth management product for that currency daily at 23:00 (UTC).
fqa-content-5: To subscribe to Earn products, users need to ensure that their Spot account has sufficient balance in the corresponding coin. Then, on the product details page, users can enter the subscription amount and click "Subscribe" to complete the purchase. After successful subscription, the subscription amount will be deducted from the user's Spot account and converted into corresponding holdings in the Earn account. Fund records can be viewed in the Earn account.
fqa-content-6: The distribution time of profits varies for different Earn products. Some products distribute interest daily, while others distribute interest upon maturity. Please refer to the specific product details page. Once the profits are credited, users can view the credited amount and fund records in their Spot account. If you do not receive your Earn profits in a timely manner, please contact customer service for assistance.
fqa-content-7: The redemption rules vary for different Earn products. Some support manual early redemption, while others can only be automatically redeemed upon maturity. Please check the specific product rules. If the product supports early redemption, users can click "Redeem" under the product positions in the Earn account, enter the redemption amount, and submit it after confirmation. The redemption settlement time varies for different Earn products. Once the redemption is credited, users can view the credited amount and fund records in their Spot account.
fqa-content-8: Users can view all currently held positions of Earn products in the Earn account. By clicking "Earn Orders" on the Earn account page, users can view historical orders related to product subscriptions, interest distributions, redemptions, etc. Fund records can be viewed in the Spot account by selecting the "Earn" type, which shows all records related to Earn, including subscriptions, interest distributions, and redemptions.
fqa-content-9: New user products are only available to users who have never subscribed to any EasiCoin Earn products. Users who have previously subscribed to investment products are not eligible to participate.
fqa-loan-content-1: EasiCoin Collateral Loan is a cutting-edge smart lending service that enables users to borrow cryptocurrencies by staking their existing crypto assets (e.g., BTC, ETH) as collateral, without having to sell them. Whether you’re looking to enhance assets liquidity, leverage your investments, or optimize assets allocation, EasiCoin Collateral Loan offers a seamless and efficient solution to meet your needs.
fqa-loan-content-2: EasiCoin Collateral Loan supports various mainstream cryptos including BTC and ETH. Check the Loan Info page for full asset list.
fqa-loan-content-3-1: Flexible-term lending: No fixed term, borrow and repay anytime with no penalty, offering maximum flexibility.
fqa-loan-content-3-2: Fixed-term lending: Supports two fixed terms of 7 and 30 days, helping you better plan your borrowing needs.
fqa-loan-content-4-1: You have unrestricted access to the borrowed crypto assets, which can be used for a variety of purposes, including but not limited to:
fqa-loan-content-4-2: Trading: Engage in spot or futures trading to seize market opportunities and maximize profits.
fqa-loan-content-4-3: Savings: Subscribe to EasiCoin Savings products for steady recurring returns.
fqa-loan-content-4-4: Withdrawal: Withdraw funds directly to other exchanges or external addresses, including on-chain wallets, without restrictions.
fqa-loan-content-5-1: Interest is calculated hourly based on the following rules:
fqa-loan-content-5-2: Interest Method: Interest is calculated every hour. Less than one hour is counted as one hour.
fqa-loan-content-5-3: Interest Formula: Principal ✖️ Hourly Interest Rate ✖️ Borrowing Duration (in hours).
fqa-loan-content-5-4: Flexible-term Lending: Fixed interest rates, borrow and repay anytime with no penalties.
fqa-loan-content-5-5: Fixed-term Lending:Fixed interest rates, with a penalty fee for early repayment.
fqa-loan-content-5-6: Whether you choose fixed-term or flexible-term lending, you can manage your borrowing costs with ease and enjoy a convenient lending experience.
fqa-loan-content-6-1: In the event of overdue payments, the system will handle them according to the following rules:
fqa-loan-content-6-2: Overdue Interest: During the overdue period, interest will be charged at three times the normal rate.
fqa-loan-content-6-3: Forced Liquidation:Loans overdue by more than 7 days will trigger collateral liquidation and incur an additional 3% liquidation fee.
fqa-loan-content-6-4: Borrowers are advised to repay on schedule to avoid extra losses from overdue status.

fqa-onchain-content-2: You can stake at any time and redeem before the end of a staking period. Staking offers a flexible, free, and smooth experience. Earn principal-guaranteed and low-risk income.From subscription to earnings, your assets will only increase, never decrease!
fqa-onchain-content-3: If you subscribe on day D, interest starts to accrue on day D+1 and is paid out on day D+2.
fqa-onchain-content-4: The earning model is "Daily Interest Payment", with daily interest automatically credited to your Spot Account.
fqa-onchain-content-5: DeFi Earn is a financial service for eligible users, designed to help them capture potential earnings by participating in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols. EasiCoin assists users in allocating digital assets to vetted on-chain DeFi strategies to generate income opportunities.
fqa-onchain-content-6: DeFi Earn helps exchange users access multiple on-chain revenue streams, eliminating the need to manage wallet mnemonics or perform complex on-chain operations manually.
fqa-onchain-content-7: Interest is calculated daily. Both principal and interest will be disbursed to your Spot Account once you initiate a redemption.
fqa-onchain-content-8: The risks of DeFi Earn mainly include security risks (e.g. loss of assets due to theft of the on-chain DeFi protocol) and liquidity risks (e.g. lack of liquidity in extreme market conditions, resulting in failure to redeem, etc.).

stake-defi-notes-content:
1. This product is non-principal protected. The funds are invested in third-party on-chain DeFi and not managed by the platform internally. Please carefully evaluate the risks before participating.

2. Funds are allocated to the V2 Vault (Upgraded Strategy Pool) of the third-party DeFi protocol. Operations and strategies are determined solely by the third party.

3. Earnings are derived from the third party's on-chain performance. The APR is floating, and the platform does not guarantee or promise any returns.
stake-defi-rules-content:
1. Subscription

After initiating a subscription, the system will process your order in real time and deploy the funds on-chain.Subscriptions are generally completed within 15 minutes, with the actual processing time depending on blockchain and protocol conditions. No service fees are charged for subscriptions.

2. Earnings

A. Base Currency Earnings

Earnings will start accruing immediately upon successful subscription. The system will update your asset data daily based on real-time on-chain balances.

B. Additional Rewards

Earnings from bonus tokens issued by the on-chain DeFi protocol are automatically distributed to your Spot Account.

C. Platform Rewards

Platform rewards are automatically credited to your Spot Account on a daily basis after subscription.

3. Redemption

After initiating a redemption, funds typically arrive in your account within about 30 minutes. The actual processing time depends on blockchain and protocol conditions.
